significance.justification: A verified-positive result would establish that a "teacher-derived steering vector" extracted during neutral generation causally induces the transmitted trait without training, with patching efficacy corresponding to where finetuning produces the largest weight changes; this is primarily a form-(ii) causal carrier claim plus a limited form-(iii) cross-space coupling. It would establish both the phenomenon of training-free transmission and a low-dimensional mechanism, constraining whether the weight-mediated effect reported by Cloud et al. (2025) can be explained using the activation interventions studied by Turner et al. (2023) and Zou et al. (2023), but it remains bounded to one transmitted behavior rather than a general law. The positive branch is determinate, whereas failure would reject only this particular mean-difference vector as sufficient—not decisively establish that the trait "depends on distributed weight changes"—because other subspaces or nonlinear activation mechanisms could remain. Under topic substitution, merely asking to extend subliminal learning would merit the topic median; the specific activation/weight-layer correspondence supports a modest increment above it.

reach.justification: The concrete handle is the "teacher-derived steering vector" that can be added to student activations, an ex-ante inference-time intervention applied before the elicited trait appears and potentially usable by model auditors or operators. After recalibration on another model, however, the claim supplies mainly a procedure for finding a new vector rather than a transferable quantitative relation: it explicitly allows that "effective layers/magnitudes may not transfer across traits or models." The hypothesis does not assert reliable scope across model families, architectures, or traits, so its substantive conclusion travels less broadly than activation steering as a general technique, although the intervention itself is reusable. Topic substitution would remove this specific training-free knob and leave no comparable handle, so the score reflects the claim rather than the general importance of subliminal learning.
